mark: Its quantizer bench: gain beyond the interval, bit-exact
evidence: README section 4 pytest (-k selection over 4 files, host nvdisasm mounted as in the README; patched-file mounts dropped because the image carries 0764) and README section 5 bench, bench_hw_e2m1x2_quant.py --out (defaults: 80 interleaved AB/BA rounds x 25 repeats, 5 for M >= 2048), on the candidate image, two boots. The bench is self-contained: its sw arm is the 1107 software E2M1 kernels re-declared in the script, its hw arm the image's kernels, each case checked torch.equal before timing. The same bench on 1107 cannot import (it needs _E2M1_HEADER from the patched gemm.py); recorded once

measured.bit_exact: all 45 (kernel, M) cases torch.equal on both boots, including the E2M1 tie midpoints

median_us_sw_boots_to_hw_boots.quantize_query_rope_M2048: 75.61/76.57 -> 76.566/80.838 (0.967x, within the interval; paired deltas +1.27% / +5.58%; PR claimed 1.36x-1.42x)

measured.cells: 45: 7 faster beyond the two-boot interval (the above, plus paged keys M=32 at 1.049x), 33 within it, 5 slower beyond it

slower_beyond_interval.note: the PR's own receipts show the same paged-key decode-shape regressions (+1.4% to +6.1%) and a mixed M=2048 (+5.38% / -0.06%)

measured.same_command_on_1107: exit 1: ImportError cannot import name '_E2M1_HEADER' (the bench needs the patched gemm.py)
measured.interval: two candidate-image boots; each value is the median of 80 interleaved rounds; a gain is beyond the interval when the slower hw boot beats the faster sw boot. Boot-to-boot spread is large in some decode cells (query rope M=1: 4.268 vs 12.431 us for sw), so the per-boot paired deltas are given too

parts.part: quantizer bench: gain beyond the interval
parts.detail: the prefill headline gains reproduce beyond the interval (query rope M=512 1.555x, paged keys M=8192 2.005x, norm-rope M=8192 1.241x, GEMM epilogue M=32/64 4-6%); the claimed query-rope M=2048 gain does not reproduce, and five decode-shape cells (GEMM M=1, paged keys M=2..6) and paged keys M=2048 are 0.6%-6% slower beyond the interval
45 of 45 cases torch.equal on both boots

verdict_scope: its own bench on the candidate image; whether the 0.04-0.2 us decode-shape slowdowns move the decode suite is a cluster question
reason: The hardware e2m1x2 quantizers are bit-exact and give the PR's prefill gains on the integrated image beyond the two-boot interval, with the PR's SASS reductions. Not every claim holds: query-rope M=2048 shows no gain, and the decode-shape paged-key writes and the M=1 GEMM epilogue are slightly slower, as the PR's own receipts already showed for the paged keys.
notes: commands.txt start_utc is when the command was issued and includes any wait on /tmp/spark-lab-gpu.lock
The README's pytest receipts end with a 'PDL sources: 55 kernels launched, 55 with PDL, 0 violations' line; our runs of the same command print no such line (its source was not investigated)
